# Shipping a release

## How a release ships

Every release starts when the release manager drafts the notes from the merged pull requests. A second engineer then reviews each change and either approves it or sends it back for fixes. Once approved, the build is signed, uploaded to the download server, and published. Finally, customers are notified by email and the team watches the error dashboards for a day.

## Who to ask

Questions about a release go to the release manager on duty. They keep the calendar of upcoming releases in the team wiki.
